question: Which tiny insect flies around the flowers in a garden? 🌸
explanation: Awesome! Beautiful butterflies fly from flower to flower in the garden! 🦋

question: What colour is the soft grass in the garden? 🌿
explanation: Great job! The fresh grass in a garden is a lovely green colour. 🌿
hint: It is the colour of leaves.

question: Which sweet insect makes buzzing sounds near flowers? 🐝
explanation: Super! Bees buzz around to collect sweet nectar from flowers. 🍯

question: What do we give to plants to help them grow? 💧
explanation: Fantastic! Plants drink water to grow tall and strong. 🌱

question: Which beautiful red flower has a sweet smell? 🌹
explanation: Excellent! A rose is a very beautiful red flower in the garden. 🌹

question: What shines brightly in the sky to warm the garden? ☀️
explanation: Brilliant! The bright sun gives light and warmth to the plants. 🌻

question: Which tall plant gives us cool shade in the garden? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! Big trees have many leaves and give us nice shade. 🌳
hint: It has a strong brown trunk.

question: What falls from the clouds to wash the leaves? 🌧️
explanation: Super! Rain gives fresh water to all the thirsty plants. 💧

question: Which slow animal carries a shell on its back? 🐌
explanation: Great job! A snail moves very slowly on the garden leaves. 🐌
hint: It hides in its round shell.

question: Who sings sweet songs sitting on the tree branches? 🐦
explanation: Wow! Birds build nests in trees and sing lovely songs. 🎶

question: What insect is small, red, and has black spots? 🐞
explanation: Fantastic! Ladybugs are cute little red bugs with black spots. 🐞

question: What tool do we use to water the flowers? 🚿
explanation: Excellent! We fill a watering can to gently water our plants. 🪴
hint: It has a spout for water.

question: Which hardworking insect walks in a long line? 🐜
explanation: Brilliant! Ants are tiny and work together in the garden. 🐜

question: What green animal jumps around near a garden pond? 🐸
explanation: Awesome! Frogs love to hop and say 'ribbit' near the water. 🐸

question: Where do plants put their roots to grow? 🌱
explanation: Great job! Plants grow their roots deep down in the soft soil. 🪴
hint: It is brown dirt on the ground.

question: Which long animal wiggles inside the garden mud? 🪱
explanation: Super! Earthworms wiggle in the mud and help the plants grow. 🌱
hint: It has no arms or legs.

question: What falls from the trees during the autumn season? 🍂
explanation: Fantastic! Tree leaves turn yellow and fall to the ground. 🍁

question: What is the most fun thing to do in a garden? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Excellent! The garden is a wonderful place to run and play. 🎾
hint: You do this with your friends.

question: What colour is the clear sky above the garden? ☁️
explanation: Brilliant! The daytime sky is a beautiful bright blue. ☀️
hint: It is the colour of the ocean.

question: Which sweet red fruit can grow on a garden tree? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! Tasty apples grow on big apple trees. 🌳

question: Which juicy yellow fruit grows in summer gardens? 🥭
explanation: Great job! Mangoes are sweet and yellow summer fruits. ☀️
hint: It is the king of fruits.

question: What part of the plant hides under the ground? 🌱
explanation: Super! Roots hold the plant tight and drink water from the soil. 💧
hint: They look like long fingers in the mud.

question: What do we plant in the soil to grow a new flower? 🌰
explanation: Fantastic! A tiny seed grows into a big, beautiful plant. 🌱
hint: It is very small and brown.

question: Which tool helps us dig holes in the garden? ⛏️
explanation: Excellent! A shovel is perfect for digging up soft mud. 🪴

question: Where do mother birds keep their eggs in the tree? 🪹
explanation: Brilliant! Birds build cosy nests to keep their baby eggs safe. 🥚
hint: It is made of twigs and grass.

question: What green bug eats leaves and turns into a butterfly? 🐛
explanation: Awesome! A caterpillar eats a lot of leaves before becoming a butterfly! 🦋
hint: It is long, green, and fuzzy.

question: What does a spider spin to catch small bugs? 🕸️
explanation: Great job! Spiders make sticky webs to catch their food. 🕷️
hint: It looks like a delicate net.

question: Which animal has eight legs and lives in the garden? 🕷️
explanation: Super! Spiders are helpful friends that have eight long legs. 🕸️

question: When is a great time to water the garden? 🌅
explanation: Fantastic! Plants love getting fresh water in the bright morning. ☀️
hint: It is when you wake up.

question: What invisible thing makes the leaves rustle and move? 🌬️
explanation: Excellent! The gentle wind blows through the trees and moves the leaves. 🍃
hint: You can feel it blowing on your face.

question: What is the hard, rough outside of a tree trunk called? 🪵
explanation: Brilliant! Tree bark protects the tree just like our skin protects us. 🌳

question: Where can we grow a small plant on our balcony? 🪴
explanation: Awesome! A flowerpot is a perfect little home for a plant. 🌱
hint: It is made of clay or plastic.

question: What do we do with our nose when we find a pretty rose? 👃
explanation: Great job! Flowers have wonderful scents for us to smell. 🌸

question: Which lovely flower has white petals and a yellow centre? 🌼
explanation: Super! Daisies are happy little flowers that look like tiny suns. ☀️

question: Which pink flower floats on the water in a garden pond? 🪷
explanation: Fantastic! The beautiful lotus flower loves to grow in the water. 💧
hint: It sits on a large green leaf.

question: Who swims happily in the garden pond? 🐟
explanation: Excellent! Colourful fish love swimming in cool pond water. 🌊
hint: It has fins and a tail.

question: Which bird goes 'quack quack' near the garden water? 🦆
explanation: Brilliant! Ducks are funny birds that love to paddle and quack. 🦆

question: Which green bug takes long leaps in the grass? 🦗
explanation: Awesome! Grasshoppers have strong legs for jumping high in the grass. 🌿

question: What colourful arch appears in the sky after the rain? 🌈
explanation: Great job! A rainbow has seven beautiful colours and looks like magic. ✨
hint: It has red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet.

question: How does a garden full of blooming flowers look? ✨
explanation: Super! A blooming garden is a beautiful place to be. 🌺

question: What dark shape do you see on the ground when standing in the sun? 👤
explanation: Fantastic! The sun makes our shadows stretch out on the grass. ☀️

question: What sweet treat do trees give us to eat? 🍉
explanation: Excellent! Trees give us healthy and delicious fruits. 🍎

question: What are the soft, colourful parts of a flower called? 🌸
explanation: Brilliant! Petals make the flower look bright and lovely. 🌺

question: What green part holds the flower up straight? 🌿
explanation: Awesome! The stem is like the flower's body, keeping it standing tall. 🌻
hint: It connects the roots to the flower.

question: What do small plants do every day with sunlight and water? 📈
explanation: Great job! With love and care, tiny plants grow into big ones. 🌱

question: How do we feel when we play in a beautiful garden? 😃
explanation: Super! Being in nature and playing makes us feel very happy. ✨

question: What is a large public garden with swings called? 🏞️
explanation: Fantastic! A park is a huge garden where all friends can play. 🛝

question: What do we call eating our lunch outdoors on the garden grass? 🧺
explanation: Excellent! A picnic with yummy food is so much fun in the garden. 🥪
hint: You sit on a mat with a basket.

question: With all the red, yellow, and blue flowers, the garden is very...? 🎨
explanation: Brilliant! A healthy garden is filled with bright and cheerful colours. 🌈
hint: It looks like a box of crayons.

question: What glows in the sky when the garden goes to sleep at night? 🌙
explanation: Awesome! The quiet moon shines down on the sleeping garden. 🌌
